question: A mixture of sodium bicarbonate and a mild edible acid is known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** baking powder.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Baking powder**

 
 
• Baking powder is a** dry chemical **leavening ingredient that is created by mixing a carbonate or bicarbonate with a weak acid.
 
• The base and acid don't interact too rapidly when a buffer, such as **cornflour**, is present.
 
• Baking powder is used to increase the volume and texture of baked goods.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bleaching powder**

 
 
• It is employed in the textile sector as a bleaching agent for cotton and linen as well as for the** laundry's usage** in bleaching soiled clothing.
 
• Due to its potent **oxidizing properties**, it is employed as an oxidizer in several industries.
 
• It is employed as a disinfectant to purify water so that it may be consumed.
 
 
 
• **Washing soda**
 
 
• By tying to the minerals in the water, washing soda **"softens" **the water, enabling the detergents to extract dirt from the cloth.
 
• Also useful for **removing grease **from pots and pans and coffee and tea stains from ceramics are washing soda.
 
 
 
• **Baking soda**
 
 
• A** versatile component** with several use outside of cooking, baking soda.
 
• This common home item excels in cleaning and** deodorizing** because it can get rid of stubborn stains, and bad odors, and clean hard-to-reach places like the oven, microwave, and tile grout.
